# Bundled icon packs

These pinned Iconify packs are shipped with the app. Runtime loading uses only app assets.

- **Tabler Icons 1.2.42** (6,480 icons), Paweł Kuna — MIT: [full license](tabler-LICENSE.txt), [source](https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons).
- **Lucide 1.2.141** (2,160 icons), Lucide Contributors — ISC: [full license](lucide-LICENSE.txt), [source](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide).
- **Carbon 1.2.28** (2,793 icons), IBM — Apache-2.0: [full license](carbon-LICENSE.txt), [source](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/tree/main/packages/icons).
- **Phosphor 1.2.2** (9,198 icons), Phosphor Icons — MIT: [full license](ph-LICENSE.txt), [source](https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core).
- **Fluent UI System Color Icons 1.2.21** (890 icons), Microsoft Corporation — MIT: [full license](fluent-color-LICENSE.txt), [source](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons).
- **SVG Logos 1.2.15** (2,208 icons), Gil Barbara — CC0-1.0: [full license](logos-LICENSE.txt), [source](https://github.com/gilbarbara/logos).

Icon data rendering uses **@iconify/utils 3.1.7**, MIT: [full license](iconify-utils-LICENSE.txt).

The icon data is unmodified; whitespace is compacted for distribution. The manifest records source versions and SHA-256 hashes. Run `npm run build:icons` to reproduce the assets from package-lock.json. License files are retained for offline rebuilds.
